title: error answer
description: What a docked service answers in place of a result when it did not do what it was asked. See errors.md. Also checked by Station, beyond this schema: (1) Station counts a string's length in UTF-8 bytes where the contract says bytes, and otherwise in UTF-16 code units; the schema counts characters at the same bound, so a string with characters outside ASCII can pass the schema and still be too long. (2) Text a service writes for people or a model to read also holds no tag character (U+E0000 to U+E007F) and no lone surrogate; the `pattern` covers the rest of that rule. (3) No object anywhere in the answer holds a `__proto__`, `constructor` or `prototype` key, and nothing nests deeper than 40 levels (an opaque object, 32). (4) `retryable` is true for `rate_limited` and `unavailable` and false for every other code. (5) `retry_after_ms` is given only on a retryable code.
